purpose: Teach: 陶器/アミノ酸/音符/管弦楽/画素/サンダル/ギタリスト/リアクション

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが陶器作りに通われたぞ
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he used to spend time making pottery.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful voice. Gazes into the middle distance. Warm nostalgia without sadness. Measured pace, letting each image settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、アミノ酸の研究をしてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, and your father was always so devoted to his research on amino acids, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gently corrective, as if lovingly steering the conversation. Tender but slightly mischievous — she's testing whether he remembers correctly. Warm, familiar lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが楽譜の音符を読まれたぞ
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he could read sheet music beautifully.
lines.style: Same wistful register — softer this time, as if the memory of music touches him. Slight pause after 'young,' letting that youth linger. Quiet conviction in his voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、管弦楽の演奏会を欠かさず行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and he never missed an orchestra concert, did he, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate, with a knowing undertone. She's not quite correcting him, but gently offering another thread of their shared past. Her voice finds a little lilt on 'dear' — intimacy without pressing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがカメラの画素を気にされたぞ
lines.en: When your father was younger, he was always particular about camera quality and detail.
lines.style: The same distant, warm quality. Slight breathiness — as if he's surprised by how clearly he remembers this small thing. Even pace, but with small pauses between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夏はいつもサンダルを履いてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he always wore sandals in the summer, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: A gentle, almost playful correction — she's weaving her own memory in alongside his. Warm and close, as if they're sitting shoulder to shoulder looking at an old photograph together. Soft close on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがギタリストの友人をご招待されたぞ
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he invited his guitarist friend over quite often.
lines.style: A slight shift — softer smile in the voice now. The memory has warmth and light. Still wistful, but with a thread of gentle affection running through it. Pace opens up just a little.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、面白いお話に大きなリアクションをされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and he always laughed so hard at funny stories, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmest yet. She's close to him now, voice intimate and knowing. A smile threaded through. Final 'dear' is whispered almost, like she's remembering something private and precious with him. Gentle fade.
